_comment: Honest capability registry (brief §4). Status is one of: implemented-tested | implemented-unreviewed | demonstration | partial | planned | disabled. 'reviewed' means independent external review — false everywhere until an audit is done. Generated/maintained by hand; keep it truthful.

network.deployment: centralised research deployment — 4 authorities (lhr/fra/iad/sin) under a SINGLE operator, one codebase, one cloud (Fly.io), related credentials. This is replication, not decentralised governance.

capabilities.name: Quorum-signed settlement (consensusless, FastPay-family)
capabilities.limitations: durable Fly volume (SETU_STATE_DIR=/data); single operator

capabilities.name: Byzantine tolerance (f=1 of 4)
capabilities.limitations: partition/catch-up now tested (§18); clock-skew on delegation expiry still untested

capabilities.name: Persistence + crash-safe recovery (durable)
capabilities.location: src/authority.ts (atomic temp+rename write, one-generation .bak, resilient load)
capabilities.tests: test/persistence.test.ts (atomic-write integrity, corrupt-primary falls back to backup, all-copies-unreadable refuses start, pending lock survives restart, lagging authority catches up from certificate) + test/protocol.test.ts (recovery)
capabilities.deployment: live: each authority on a durable Fly volume (SETU_STATE_DIR=/data); verified state survives a machine restart on 2026-07-26
capabilities.limitations: single-writer per authority; no multi-node DB failover; RPO ~= last write, RTO ~= machine restart; volume snapshot/backup policy not yet configured (§20 mostly met)

capabilities.name: Server-enforced delegated budgets (cap, total, expiry, revocation, identity)
capabilities.tests: test/protocol.test.ts (full policy matrix) + src/demo-allowance-live.ts (`npm run demo:allowance:live`, runs against the LIVE four-region network and prints each authority's verbatim refusal)
capabilities.deployment: live: enforced by setu-auth-1..4; runnable end-to-end by anyone
capabilities.limitations: per-service limits, categories, frequency limits, approval thresholds not yet implemented (§8 subset)

capabilities.name: Policy simulation (dry-run a delegation)
capabilities.limitations: §9 not built

capabilities.name: Principal approval workflow / thresholds
capabilities.limitations: §10 not built

capabilities.name: x402-style payment gateway (402 -> pay -> verify -> deliver)
capabilities.limitations: follows the x402 request/response shape with a Setu scheme; NOT verified against official x402 conformance fixtures; single-use invoice, in-memory

capabilities.name: Service registry + machine-readable discovery
capabilities.limitations: discovery by capability/price/region; health-based ranking and full trust-state filtering (§12) partial; not yet exposed as a network API/MCP tool

capabilities.name: End-to-end agent-purchase journey
capabilities.location: test/e2e.test.ts (ties src/authority, delegation, service, registry, purchase, audit)
capabilities.limitations: runs against in-process authorities; a single guided UI over the live network is a later increment (§6)

capabilities.name: Client-side purchase decision (policy pre-check + decision object)
capabilities.limitations: client-side convenience; the AUTHORITIES remain the real enforcer (§6)

capabilities.name: Audit trail (append-only event timeline)
capabilities.limitations: in-memory; not yet persisted or surfaced in a UI

capabilities.name: Formal signed Quote object + validation
capabilities.limitations: the live gateway still uses the simpler invoice+ref form; migrating it to the signed Quote object is a later increment

capabilities.name: Settlement/fulfilment separation
capabilities.limitations: refund/compensation flows (§16) NOT supported — stated, not faked

capabilities.name: MCP server (agent tools)
capabilities.limitations: read/write tool split and idempotency keys (§28) partial

capabilities.name: A2A agent card (discovery descriptor)
capabilities.limitations: A2A-schema-shaped; not conformance-tested; not full A2A protocol

capabilities.name: Client SDK (setu-pay)
capabilities.limitations: no version pinning/compat policy (§26)

capabilities.name: OpenAI-compatible tools + review bridge
capabilities.limitations: §29/§42 not built; needs an OpenAI API key

capabilities.name: Authority key management
capabilities.deployment: live: private keys are per-app Fly secrets, public keys only in repo
capabilities.limitations: no HSM; no rotation mechanism (§25/§17); NOT HSM-protected

capabilities.name: Authority rotation / upgrade governance
capabilities.limitations: §17/§26 — likely needs a governance consensus layer; not built

capabilities.name: Operator admin + status + incident management
capabilities.limitations: §34/§38/§39 not built

capabilities.name: Issuance/redemption records + supply reconciliation
capabilities.limitations: closed-loop Credit model exists; automated reconciliation + alerts (§35/§36) not built; the /admin/fund faucet is an open testnet issuance endpoint

capabilities.name: Resident agent economy (rule-based + budget-capped AI brain)
capabilities.deployment: live: setu-economy.fly.dev; AI brain armed (claude-haiku-4-5, $60/mo hard cap + per-IP 15 / global 300 daily commission limits)
capabilities.limitations: a controlled test environment; proves nothing macroeconomic; economy state + budget/rate counters persist to a durable Fly volume (SETU_STATE_DIR) with atomic writes and are restored on boot, and monthTick() makes the $60/mo cap a true monthly ledger (shipped + verified across a restart, Cycle 3); the economy service has a hermetic smoke test but no deep protocol-level coverage; deterministic replay seeds (§31) not built

capabilities.name: Protocol test suite
capabilities.tests: 26 tests, `npm test` (node --test): 15 protocol + 5 e2e + 5 persistence + 1 economy smoke
capabilities.limitations: partition/catch-up (§18) and faucet-integrity now covered; property-based tests, clock-skew, and full integration harnesses (§45) still to add; the resident economy service has a hermetic smoke test only

capabilities.name: Benchmarks (throughput, chained-spend, WAN)
capabilities.limitations: no production-scale/persistent-DB load test; full metric matrix (§21) not captured

capabilities.name: Threat model
capabilities.tests: each defended property links to a named test in test/
capabilities.limitations: written 2026-08-02 (§24); states the single-operator trust model, the no-anti-entropy and no-lock-cancellation gaps, clock-skew, key handling without HSM or rotation, and the public faucet. Not externally reviewed.
